cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: In your thank-you speech, mention that I hammered every board twice, just like you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was tapping for rotten wood. You drove good nails through the bottom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, testing their depth. You should say I made the inspection thorough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did find the rotten plank near the steps. We replaced it before the dancers arrived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then name that plank and name me. 'Helped with the stage' won't tell them what I prevented.

reason: Give S04 a particular misunderstood imitation which changes the Drive tactic. Preserve responsive B turns and explicitly stated essential facts; remove generic confidence prefaces.
